name: pack-concurrent
summary: The packed prefill (STRATA_PACK_PREFILL: the prompts sent ahead by waiting requests read with this one in the same chunks, the experts streamed once for all of them) also beside STRATA_PIPED_CONCURRENT: the prefixes go into the pack slots on the host thread with nothing in flight, Prefill::run_packed runs on the read's thread while the slot groups keep decoding, the pack slots' checkpoints are taken after the drain. Without it the concurrent read returned before pk_read and never packed.
switch: `STRATA_PACK_CONCURRENT=1` (off), with `STRATA_PACK_PREFILL=N` and `STRATA_PIPED_CONCURRENT=1`; a packed read takes no BYIELD
upstream_status: never proposed; 0.2.0-beta (upstream/main f57c0adc) still reads admissions one at a time and has no multi-sequence prefill
measured: Compiled and run 19 Oct: see docs/MULTICHAT.md (passata unica) - to be filled from the letture_concorrenti bench (4 readers of 2-4k on 40-100k cached + 2 writers, B-A-B) and the replay.
depends_on: STRATA_PACK_PREFILL / Prefill::run_packed (lab/multichat43 -> lab/multichat45, not an entry of this stack: it is carried on the multi-chat branch) and STRATA_PIPED_CONCURRENT (#2326, in 0.1.45)
notes: pk_read is now pk_prepare + Prefill::run_packed + pk_finish; the path without the switch is the three in a row (behaviour unchanged).
intro_extra: Patch 21 (19 Oct 2026, branch `lab/passata-unica` from `lab/multichat45b`) makes the packed prefill of the multi-chat branch run beside the concurrent read (`STRATA_PACK_CONCURRENT`); it depends on the pack commits of that branch, which are not entries of this stack.
